data.one_liner: Highlight text by tags with specific styles and tap actions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TagHighlightText widget that parses custom tags within text strings to apply styles, tap actions, or custom widget builders. Supports nested or multiple distinct tag types for rich text formatting.
use_when: You need to highlight specific parts of text using HTML-like tags.
You want to attach tap actions or custom widgets to specific tagged words in a text block.
avoid_when: You need standard Markdown or RichText without custom markup tags.
You require complex multi-language localization formatting engines.
strengths: Simple tag-based syntax for text styling and interaction.
Supports custom widget builders for advanced inline elements.
Easy setup with standard Flutter TextStyle and callback actions.
weaknesses: Relies on custom string parsing instead of standard formats like Markdown.
